en.answer:
If there isn't at least 1 WATER Beast-Warrior-Type monster in both your hand and Graveyard when the effect of <<11036>> resolves, the effect does not resolve.

(Not even 1 monster is Special Summoned, and the <<11036>> that activated the effect does not return to the hand.)
en.question: If at the time of the resolution of the effect of <<11036>> you have no more WATER Winged-Beast-Type monsters in your hand or Graveyard, how does the effect resolve?
en.title: If at the time of the resolution of the effect of <<11036>> you have no more WATER Winged-Beast-Type monsters in your hand or Graveyard, how does the effect resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<11036>>」の効果処理にて、自分の手札と自分の墓地から、「<<11036>>」以外の鳥獣族・水属性モンスターをそれぞれ1体ずつ特殊召喚できないのであれば、効果処理は適用されません。
（モンスターは1体も特殊召喚されず、効果を発動した「<<11036>>」自身も手札に戻りません。）
ja.question: 「<<11036>>」の効果処理時に自分の手札・墓地のいずれかに鳥獣族・水属性のモンスターが存在しなくなった場合、処理はどうなりますか？
